The horizontal axis displays categories labeled with numerical values ranging from 34 to 77, presumably identifying individual LLMs, and they appear to be sorted in descending order based on performance. The vertical axis, labeled “Overall Performance (%)”, has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. There are nine individual bars, all colored in shades of gray and green. The first bar, representing the category labeled 77, is the tallest, reaching approximately 76.24%, while the bar for category 34 is the shortest, extending to about 34.24%. The bar for category 72 reaches 72.09%, and the bar for category 64 touches 64.34%. Based on the provided caption, these LLMs are stratified into three tiers: Tier-1 comprises models with performance between 72 and 77, Tier-2 between 64 and 68, and Tier-3 between 34 and 46.
